disposition_reason: Primary (preprint) measurements of cadmium and lead in white sugar from five production batches.

study.design: Preprint; analysis of white sugar from five annual production batches of one Ethiopian cane sugar factory, plus proximate composition
study.origin: Omo Kuraz sugar factory, Ethiopia (cane sugar)
study.period_text: production batches 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022 and 2023; collection dates not reported
study.method: Single-drop microextraction (Rhodamine B iodide ion pair into diisopropylpentanone/CCl4) followed by graphite furnace AAS
study.lod_text: LOD 0.0019-0.0062 mg/L and LOQ 0.0065-0.021 mg/L (range across Cd and Pb, in solution)

unresolved: Preprint, not peer reviewed. Abstract says AAS; methods say SDME-GFAAS.
Text refers to "five sampling sites" while the table is by production year; sample handling per batch (number of bags, storage time) not described.
Proximate results (ash 3.00-4.66%, protein 1.07-1.57%, fat 1.25-2.08%) are implausible for refined white sugar, which raises questions about sample identity or methods.
LOD/LOQ given only in mg/L of solution; mass-based LOD not stated.
